Round-two scoped review of tests/screenshots.spec.ts against targeted screenshot capture and fixture-fidelity guidance. The20 selected consent scenes retain desktop/phone/DNT/operator-endpoint coverage and add the requested DNT Settings and Detailed-expanded phone poses. All three option rows are measured for44px floor, equal heights and equal gaps; native Technical details is exercised and collapsed again. The two extra mobile scenes use an ordinary hover/wheel gesture and assert text sits above the standard floating Save bar. The fixture reads authoritative config/disclosure/status once per scene from the explicitly owned API origin through createAuthenticatedE2ERequest, validates successful responses/revision prerequisites, then fulfills browser reads with cloned snapshots. This avoids the observed per-page UI-proxy connection reset without retrying mutations or converting read errors to success. The canonical helper closes direct API connections and refuses foreign origins. Existing unknown-request handling, fixture audit, partial-gallery manifest and isolated-instance ownership remain. The guide already documents direct targeted Playwright capture; no prose change is required. Typecheck:e2e and fixture policy checks passed; capture results are retained separately and do not qualify real receiver, physical device or hosted behavior. The larger-gesture mobile comparison passed with the proposed ending-padding rule removed. Thus the earlier180px fixture was insufficient, not evidence of a product scroll limit; the unnecessary CSS/root class were removed. The strict confirmation-above-Save assertion remains. No forced positioning or assertion relaxation was used.
